summary.value: Carbone is Mario Carbone's Italian-American restaurant on Thompson Street in Greenwich Village, and the room itself is the show: charismatic service, captains sporting tuxedos by Zac Posen, artworks by the likes of Julian Schnabel. It is a special-occasion booking, and Restaurantji diners back that up, calling it A must see and experience when in NY and saying the hosts go above and beyond for that true over the top experience.

description.value: Carbone is an Italian-American restaurant located on historic Thompson Street in Greenwich Village. Wikipedia places the original at 181 Thompson Street. Its official site describes captains sporting tuxedos by Zac Posen, and reservations are famously hard to get, so book well ahead. Restaurantji shows 4.2 822 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “The food was exceptional, the decor is so chic”; “Roberto was a sensational waiter”. Restaurantji diners rate it 4.2 822 ratings; one party celebrating a birthday and a new job wrote that the team made it extra special, and another advises that It’s worth securing a reservation when they go live.
